title: P104: nine downward binary contacts are necessary and sufficient
body:
## Sharp communication bound
The fixed 630-output operator needs exactly nine downward one-bit messages. The converse grants free upward traffic, unlimited local memory and arbitrary deterministic nonlinear encoders on the binary scalar channel. A 13-port index-code witness yields five independent bits that eight broadcasts would have to encode at four binary endpoints. The lean achieving word takes 27 downward MOVEs to nine, preserves all 2,776 upward contacts, saves 56 instructions, two XORs and 18 peak owners, and restores all retained clear values and charts. At κ = 0.00389046 its downward tariff rises by 8.696447871129279893… per call. With the native upward receipts and two deadlines fixed, every one of nine direct-to-zero responses must originate at the identity chart. No κ increase is claimed from this word.

## Inputs and overlap
Main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57; #8027 fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4; #8041 05f6172d4d9487090fa24c75137a7c60e6fcd67e. The earlier p104-e8-rank8-closure supplies the linear Hall pattern. #8043 treats upward grade and a different relay. This proof derives the side-information pattern from physical nesting and rules out nonlinear binary encoders. The #7257 prerequisite is 0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026. Candidate word SHA256 4a4bd4faf0b084fbdc4c3e671eea3895c8318bb42aaf44c7afebef7859bb8f2a.

## Replay and next question
CPython 3.12: python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-nine-downward-contacts. Final local registered replay passed in 28.12 s; all 630 forward/adjoint rows and 3,415 retained dirty clears agree. Removing a live donor changes 55 rows. Two implementations verify 1,272 sender/deadline intersections. The proof requires a one-bit contact; unrestricted wide rational/integer messages change the channel. A signed supplier needs separate all-column, ownership/erasure and paid-caller evidence. The next experiment changes an intermediate destination or its information before the return deadline.

Ali Romman supplied the graph and paid construction. The E8 contributors supplied the earlier linear obstruction, DreamingOfClouds the #7852 toolkit, and Clear1nsight coordinated this work with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
